help: This is a JSON object mapping column names to arrays of allowed values. Multiple columns can be filtered. For example, `{"A":["0","1"]}`.
name: search
label: Filter

help: Order in which to return results. If a single column name is given (e.g. `pet`), results are placed in ascending order of values in that column. Multiple columns can be specified, separated by commas (e.g. `pet,age`). For descending order, prefix a column name with a `-` character (e.g. `pet,-age`).
name: sort
label: Sort

help: Maximum number of items to output.
name: limit
label: Limit
